evidence.title: Momentum in the dynamics of variable-mass systems: classical and relativistic case
evidence.finding: Variable-mass-body equations explicitly include relative velocities of transferred mass.
Individually checked closed/open-system momentum balance, center-of-mass scattering, torque and angular-momentum identities, inertia, rolling dynamics and numerical torque/power calculations.

For a vehicle exchanging mass at inertial velocity u, d(m*v)/dt=F_external+u*dm/dt, hence m*v_dot=F_external+(u-v)*dm/dt. Thrust depends on relative velocity, not simply the remaining vehicle velocity v.
Reject the open-system/rocket inference without disputing the algebraic product rule or the closed-material-system momentum law.

evidence.finding: Individually checked closed/open-system momentum balance, center-of-mass scattering, torque and angular-momentum identities, inertia, rolling dynamics and numerical torque/power calculations.
